newsitem.title: INDIA: India Dr Reddy's down 9.8 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Dr Reddy's down 9.8 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Indian pharmaceuticals firm Dr Reddy's Laboratories fell 18.50 rupees or 9.87 percent to 169 at noon on Monday after the firm announced disappointing first half results, traders said.
Dr Reddy's said on Friday its net profit in the first six months to September 30, 1996 fell to 162.7 million rupees from 238.3 million a year ago.

"Non-operating expenditure like higher depreciation and higher provision for income tax due to Minimum Alternate Tax and lower other income have resulted in a decline in net profit," the firm said in a statement.
